decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach to the single left-side tube; lift and pitch the open left gripper while right stays at origin.
Advance left gripper above the tube while pitching toward a downward approach, maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Lower open gripper toward left tube body and finish matching its axis; check wrist centering before closing.
Fine-align tube between left fingers, lower the final few millimeters and close; retention will be checked during lift.
Lift the closed left gripper and tube clear of the table, checking that the tube remains between the fingers.
Tube appears retained. Carry toward a left rack slot while gradually turning the tube upright, keeping the grasp closed.
Continue smooth transport and uprighting of the retained left tube above the left rack area.
Finish bringing the tube upright and position over a left-front large rack opening; retain clearance before descent.
Corrected stationary-right command; lower the upright left tube toward the opening and inspect before final insertion.
Gently complete the left tube's vertical insertion, keeping its orientation and grasp fixed until seated.
Release the seated left tube and retreat clear while starting the right arm's elbow-up approach to the nearer right-side tube.
Left tube is standing in its slot. Retreat left toward home; advance the open right gripper above the inner right tube while matching its diagonal axis.
Center the downward-facing right gripper above the inner tube, refining its axis from the wrist image; continue left arm's smooth homeward retreat.
Lower and center the right gripper around the tube body, slightly toward its cap; return the empty left arm to origin.
Tube is centered between the right fingers. Descend the last few millimeters and close gently before testing retention with a lift.
Lift the second tube away from the remaining tube, maintaining a closed grasp and observing retention.
Second tube appears retained. Move toward the right rack slot while slowly rotating it upright, with clearance from the first tube.
Continue the second tube's smooth upright transfer toward the right-front rack opening, preserving the closed grasp.
Finish uprighting the second tube above the right-front opening, keeping the tube well above the rack before descent.
Lower the second tube toward its right-side slot and remove the small remaining tilt; keep grasp closed for alignment inspection.
Refine the second tube slightly toward the front row and lower gently into the rightmost large opening; inspect seating before release.
Complete the last centimeter of the second insertion, then open the right gripper without lateral motion and observe whether the tube seats upright.
Second tube is standing in the opening with fingers open. Withdraw the right gripper upward and backward before approaching the final tube.
Approach the remaining right-side tube along a raised path, smoothly pitching the open right gripper downward without crossing the arms.
Continue the raised approach toward the final tube, pitching down gradually while keeping elbow-up continuity.
Finish positioning the open right gripper above the final tube; verify wrist centering before descent.
Lower above the final tube while matching its slightly different diagonal axis and centering the body between the open fingers.
Fine-center the last tube, descend the remaining millimeters and close the right fingers around its body.
Lift the final tube with the right gripper closed, verifying retention before carrying it toward the remaining slot.
Final tube appears retained. Carry it toward the middle slot along a raised path, beginning to turn upright and keeping clearance from inserted tubes.
Continue turning the retained final tube upright while carrying it inward at raised clearance above the rack.
Move the final tube inward above the inserted right tube, maintaining raised clearance and continuing the smooth upright rotation.
Finish uprighting the final tube above the middle opening, staying high until centered between the inserted tubes.
Lower the upright final tube toward the middle slot, refining its horizontal centering while keeping the grasp closed.
Continue vertical descent of the upright final tube over the middle opening, maintaining its horizontal alignment and closed grasp.
Gently insert the final tube to seating depth in the middle opening, holding its position and upright orientation before release.
The final tube appears to have met a slot rim rather than fully seated. Lift slightly, restore upright alignment and make a small front-left correction before retrying.
Retry the corrected middle-slot insertion slowly and vertically, watching for tube motion relative to the fingers.
Open the right fingers without moving the tube laterally and allow gravity to settle it; inspect whether the middle tube reaches full depth upright.
The middle tube tipped instead of seating. Withdraw the open right gripper to expose its resting position for a careful recovery, avoiding the two inserted tubes.
Create additional clearance and expose the fallen tube's endpoints before choosing a recovery grasp.
Move the empty right gripper aside for an unobstructed view of the fallen tube and prepare a new approach.
The fallen tube appears to be resting on its cap in front of the rack. Approach from the front with an upright open gripper to recover it without disturbing the seated tubes.
Descend the open right fingers around the inverted tube from the front, correcting centering before closing.
Center on the inverted tube's cylindrical body and close the right gripper for recovery, avoiding its cap and the rack.
Lift the recovered inverted tube well clear of the table and rack, keeping the grip closed before turning it upright.
The inverted tube is retained. Begin rolling the closed wrist about its approach axis to turn the tube upright in free space.
Continue rolling the retained tube toward cap-up orientation, keeping the arm position fixed and clear of the rack.
Continue the controlled wrist roll to bring the recovered tube nearly upright, maintaining the closed grasp in free space.
Finish turning the recovered tube cap-up and raise it while moving toward the middle slot, keeping clearance above the inserted tubes.
Replan after the wrist-wrap rejection: back off the roll slightly and carry the retained cap-up tube toward the middle slot at raised clearance.
